howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose timestamp
howto.text: Drag the slider or type the time in seconds (e.g. 5.5 = 5.5 seconds in); the preview shows that frame. It starts at 1 second.

howto.name: Download the frame as JPG
howto.text: FFmpeg extracts the frame at that timestamp and saves it as a JPG.

faq.q: How do I find a good thumbnail moment?
faq.a: Scrub the preview to the moment you want; the slider shows that frame before you run it. To compare several moments at once, Video to PDF lays out evenly spaced frames as PDF pages.

faq.q: What resolution will the JPG be?
faq.a: 1280 pixels wide, with the height set by the video's shape; smaller videos are scaled up to that width. Use Resize Crop Image after if you need a specific size for social media.

faq.q: Can I extract multiple thumbnails at once?
faq.a: Yes, in two ways: add several videos here to get one frame from each at the same timestamp, or use Video to PDF to lay out evenly spaced frames from one video as PDF pages.
